GitHub issue/PR search returns at most 1000 hits per query and mid-run rate limiting (HTTP 403) prevented listing every PR. total_count values are recorded even when items cannot all be retrieved.
1581 is the global author:Birfy type:pr total_count and includes non-public repositories; those names and payloads are omitted here.

ThinkFlowLab has additional public repositories besides those with a confirmed authored-PR signal. This inventory does not claim a complete contribution history for every public org repo, especially where per-repo search was rate-limited.
Commit-level searches were not exhaustively completed after the PR search rate limit. Absence of a repo from public_contributions is not proof of zero involvement.
Four owned forks have isFork=true but no parent object in GraphQL.
Star and push timestamps are a snapshot at fetch time.
